timecoded_text_to_speech.text: I'm Molly coming here and I'm currently a candidate for Lake County State University.
Hi, I'm Molly coming here and I'm currently a candidate for Lake County School Board District 4.
I have spent the last 36 years working as an employee of the Lake County School Board and during that time I served as a teacher, a dean, a sister principal and a principal.
I was principal of four schools here in Lake County and I'm very proud to say that each of those schools were high achieving schools.
It is very important to me that our students achievement is put first.
My reason for running is because I am very concerned about the turn of Lake County Schools.
I want to make sure that we continue to be the best district that we can be and I believe my 36 plus years of experience qualifies me uniquely to be that person.
As a community leader, I have served on board of directors for Cornerstone Hospice and the Central Florida YMCA.

While it's principal at the school system, I was noted as a turnaround principal based on the fact that I went into low performing Title I schools and were able to raise the student achievement gap to the point that they were A schools and making AYP.
I believe that I am the best qualified candidate secretly office in District 4 Lake County School Board.
So please, on August 18th, vote, Molly coming here, Lake County School Board District 4.
